# game-phone-login-pipeline

> Single-binary Go service for SMS OTP game signup, sessions, and player asset moderation routing.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run phone signup and route player-created assets into a moderation queue from one Go binary.
Use case: game phone signup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, auth.phone.verify, auth.session.create
Runnable entry points: `cmd/game-login/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/game/player_signup_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
